standalone_ground_truth: Fresh unprofiled task-path worker latencies, matched task/input/repetition protocol. Formal frozen s0 catalog is retained and never refit; profiled durations never feed real slowdown.
statistical_rule: Hierarchical bootstrap of independent repetition blocks and matched input indices within blocks; DeltaS=S(task_a)-S(task_b). DETECTED iff 95% CI excludes zero AND abs(point DeltaS)>frozen historical_noise_floor. No post-result threshold change.
kernel_structure_rule: Distributional distances use kernel class JSD, occupancy W1, exact resource-configuration JSD, transition-bigram JSD and count ratio. Stable structural difference requires between-task bootstrap 95% lower JSD bound > empirical within-task repeat-bootstrap Q95 JSD floor and repeated profiles; never kernel-duration weighted. Missing resource fields remain missing.
correlation_rule: Spearman descriptive on Generalist/task-pair kernel distance and absolute DeltaS, co-model observations clustered. Inferential correlation requires >=3 independent Generalist clusters; two clusters in this pilot => INSUFFICIENT_FOR_CORRELATION irrespective result. Shared-task contrasts and repeated co-model distances are not independent samples.

gate_rule.STRONG_SUPPORT: At least one Generalist has >=2 selected tasks and >=1 fixed co-model contrast satisfying DETECTED, and the same task contrast has stable kernel structural difference.
gate_rule.PARTIAL: Only structural or only interference stable evidence, or both without a same-contrast match; stop and audit.
gate_rule.NOT_SUPPORTED: Neither stable structural nor interference differences; stop this direction.
gate_rule.missing_evidence: Missing profiler/runtime evidence precludes STRONG_SUPPORT; explicitly incomplete, never fabricate a negative scientific result.

pre_GPU_accounting_correction: Sum all selected Generalist task counts, including Qwen LID; initial displayed estimate assumed equal task counts. No selection, statistical rule, workload or measurement control changed; zero GPU runs.
overlap_rule: All target samples retained in primary slowdown; min-overlap .90 is the pre-existing active-pair validity gate, no post-result per-request filtering. If any selected pair fails, report invalid-controlled-overlap and do not claim interference detection for that contrast.
characterization_carrier: Existing M6 physical endpoint 49140 MiB, single authorized RTX4090. These are standalone/active-pair metadata probes, not a resource sweep or new benchmark workload definition.
design_completed_before_GPU: Final protocol clarification/correction and code implementation completed while all model GPU-run counts were zero; execution_freeze hashes are the operative pre-GPU freeze.
